fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: Springs you to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and lands, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each one [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flycatcher's Flick
fusions.desc: A flick of the tongue that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles forward and increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Missed Me Thrice
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: your tongue strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
